rationale: EO 13476 (October 9, 2008, 73 FR 60605) is a time-limited transition order: its section 4(d) says that, unless extended by the President, it expires on February 20, 2009, and the whole order was read in the held Federal Register text. No extension, amendment or revocation of EO 13476 is held. The single history observation is the Federal Register note that cites EO 13467 of June 30, 2008 and records that the order supersedes EO 13176 of November 27, 2000: the first is a cross-reference (the council of EO 13467 is mentioned in section 2(c)) and the second records what EO 13476 itself did to EO 13176; neither affects EO 13476. The bounded searches of the U.S. Code, eCFR and the OFR catalog found no later instrument naming it. The order therefore ended on its own terms on February 20, 2009 and has no continuing predicate on 2026-10-14. Recommended: no.
